A reversible heat engine operates on the Carnot cycle shown on the temperature-entropy (T-S) diagram between TH=600 K and TL=300 K. If heat absorbed during isothermal expansion 2–3 is Qin=240 kJ, find the net work output enclosed by the cycle.

A
120.0 kJ
B
154.0 kJ
C
120.0 kJ
✓ Correct
D
80.0 kJ
View Explanation & Provenance (Answer: Option C)

Thermal efficiency from the T-S rectangle is η=1-300600=0.5. Net work output equals the rectangular enclosed cycle area Wnet=η·Qin=120.0 kJ (whereas Option A represents heat rejected Q_out to the low-temperature sink).
